dct_description_sm: Sierra Leone administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02. This dataset is structured into 4 levels: - Admin 1: 5 nan - Admin 2: 16 nan - Admin 3: 167 nan - Admin 4: 1316 nan Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 15 December 2023: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 16 August 2017: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 16 August 2017: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA West and Central Africa (ROWCA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rowca). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
